task.summary: Prepare a truthful, bilingual v0.2 launch kit, repository social preview, and privacy-safe first-user feedback path.
acceptanceCriteria: Add bilingual launch copy and draft release notes that accurately describe the current evidence and limitations.
Add a repository social preview image with accessible alt text and documented AI-generation provenance.
Add a structured first-user feedback form that prohibits PHI, secrets, private prompts, and real patient data.
Link the feedback path and open agent tasks from both repository README files.
Avoid fabricated adoption metrics, clinical-validity claims, production-readiness claims, and third-party endorsement claims.
Pass existing Java, Python, receipt, content, and independent AI review checks before publication.

scope.description: Bilingual v0.2 launch and release materials, repository social preview assets, privacy-safe feedback intake, project documentation, and contribution evidence.

tests.command: validate the feedback issue-form YAML, required privacy confirmations, repository labels, and linked GitHub targets
inspect the 1280x640 social preview dimensions, file size, metadata, rendered text, accessible alt text, and generation provenance
